requests.summary: Official Rajasthan Urban GIS page exposes Khasra Search, View Khasra Info, map navigation, and a disclaimer naming settlement-department Khasra/village boundaries and the respective urban agency.

Current public configuration inspected. It declares the Khasra layer as https://gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in/geocode/rest/services/JDA/Settlement_JDA/MapServer/0 and the village layer as layer 10; this is a service route lead, not a verified Bharatpur response.
Anonymous ArcGIS layer metadata could not be retrieved. No retry with disabled TLS verification, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was attempted.
